rules.title: Conventional Commits
rules.text: Write commit messages in Conventional Commits format (feat:, fix:, docs:, refactor:, test:, chore:).

rules.title: Small pull requests
rules.text: Keep pull requests small and focused on one change.

rules.title: Imperative commit subjects
rules.text: Write commit subjects in the imperative mood, 72 characters or fewer.

rules.title: No force push
rules.text: Never force-push to shared branches and never rewrite published history.

rules.title: Branch naming
rules.text: Name branches type/short-description, for example feat/add-login.

rules.title: Run checks before commit
rules.text: Run lint, type check and tests before committing.

rules.title: No secrets in commits
rules.text: Never commit secrets, build output or large binaries.

rules.title: Explain the why in PRs
rules.text: Describe motivation, approach and testing in the pull request description.
